label: Telling your parents
title: Telling your parents
intro: Whether and what you share with your parents is your choice. Some people find their support helps a lot.
steps: Decide what you want to share before you start.
Explain that being a carrier is common and doesn't make you ill.
Ask for their support, not for a decision.
phrases: My screening showed I carry a gene change. It doesn't make me ill.
We're getting advice from a qualified counsellor.
I'd really value your support while we learn more.
